objects.name: Analytic 2181
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a host generating rapid, sequential Transmission Control Protocol (TCP) connection attempts across multiple destination ports on Industrial Control System (ICS) device Internet Protocol (IP) addresses, targeting ICS-specific protocol ports, from a source not in the approved control server inventory. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering activity.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: netflow:ipfix
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: IPFIX/NetFlow flow record (src/dst IP, src/dst port, protocol, packets/bytes/time): source generates short-lived flows to single dst across multiple Industrial Control Systems (ICS) protocol ports (502,102,44818,20000,4840) within port scan time window, source not in approved Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) servers

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: Time window within which connections across multiple ports are considered a single scan event.
